correctness.rationale: The cube multiset mod 7 is 0 once and ±1 three times each. The resulting fibre vector is (19,6,9,0,0,9,6); each nonsingular pair lifts in seven ways, and writing both coordinates as multiples of 7 gives the 7^4 multiplicity for n≥3. At n=2 the singular contribution is 49 only over zero, and at n=3 the quotient count is R_0=1. Thus the normalized count stabilizes for every nonzero target and the finite conditional-expectation identity follows from the 49 lifts per source pair. Independently, the signed four-cube congruence has 595 solutions mod 7 (the sum of squares of the fibre vector); only the origin is singular. Each other solution lifts in 7^3 ways at each stage. The all-divisible branch at n≥3 gives 7^8 lifts per solution three levels lower, hence the normalized moment recurrence H_n=594/343+H_(n−3)/7. At n=2 it gives H_2=594/343+1/49, and H_1=595/343. This yields bounded L², Haar mean 1, second moment 99/49 and variance 50/49. The valuation classes 3j+d give an upper bound O(7^j) and the 3j+1 class a lower bound (18/7)7^j on mass 6·7^(-3j-2), proving the endpoint divergence and the full cutoff.
